symptom: `DESCRIBE` of a page emits `column Title (...)` / `column Description (...)` (datagrid columns named after a reserved keyword) that fails with `missing {IDENTIFIER, QUOTED_IDENTIFIER}` — breaks the DESCRIBE roundtrip
cause: #619 added `mdlIdent` (quote-if-reserved) for general widget names but missed datagrid column names
insight: Wrap the column name: `fmt.Sprintf("column %s", mdlIdent(colName))`. Issue #638
